purpose: Introduce the speaker’s emotional evaluation of a fact.
keywords: Emotion adjective / Vた + ことに
To my surprise, the key was in the refrigerator.
Unfortunately, the exhibition had ended yesterday.
To my delight, a letter arrived from an old friend.
formation: Emotion adjective / Vた + ことに
restrictions: Often uses 驚いた, 困った, 嬉しい, 残念な.
mistake: Use な with a な-adjective, as in 残念なことに.
